mapper.select: SELECT MI.ID AS id, MI.MILESTONE_ID AS milestoneId, MI.ISSUE_ID AS issueId, I.SUBJECT AS issueSubject, M.NAME AS milestoneName FROM milestone_issue MI INNER JOIN milestone M ON M.ID = MI.MILESTONE_ID INNER JOIN ISSUE I ON I.ID = MI.ISSUE_ID WHERE M.PRJ_ID = 4 ORDER BY MI.MILESTONE_ID, MI.ID;

SELECT T.ID, T.MILESTONE_ISSUE_ID AS milestoneIssueId, T.YEARS, T.MONTHS, T.DATES, T.TYPE_CD, T.CONTENTS FROM milestone_timeline T INNER JOIN milestone_issue MI ON MI.ID = T.MILESTONE_ISSUE_ID INNER JOIN milestone M ON M.ID = MI.MILESTONE_ID WHERE M.PRJ_ID = 4 ORDER BY T.MILESTONE_ISSUE_ID, T.YEARS, T.MONTHS, T.DATES, T.ID;
